method: position-inferred: per-context layer lists from the opaque ProtoHEFHef.mapping bytes (field 3, not in hef.proto, layout found by position); cross-checked with schema edge layers (hef.proto v4.24.0 ContextMetadata.edge_layers original_names) and fw-actions activation counts

sources.c3k_rule: https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/blob/9a1a1471ec0834041ca101d23302909809ed58bb/ultralytics/nn/tasks.py parse_model(): 'if m is C3k2: if scale in {"m", "l", "x"}: c3k = True'

position_inferred_fields.mapping: ProtoHEFHef field 3 (bytes in hef.proto; not parsed by libhailort 4.24)
position_inferred_fields.contexts: mapping.7.1[k]: .1 header {1 name, 2 index, 3 network group}, .2.1[] layer records
position_inferred_fields.layer_record: 1 type enum (meaning unknown), 2 Hailo layer name, 45 repeated original (ONNX) names

notes: no 'attn/pe' node name in the HEF
unnamed DDR buffer in the same context: dw1 20x20x2304 (context 1) - candidate for attn/pe (3x3 depthwise unrolled to 9*C features; inferred)
no DFL/decode nodes on chip: only cv2.i/cv3.i convs (decode+NMS = host nms_op)
